stimulus: Four 100 ns frames, code centers 0/255/128/127, score first frame. Fixed 0 and 0.9 V references and TT passives.
setup: Spectre X MX, 10 ps maxstep, 5 ps saved strobes. Edge times linearly interpolated at half instantaneous VDD.
limitations: Schematic. No extracted parasitics, mismatch, transient noise, supply ramp or all-device terminal-voltage scan. Top CL_COMP_P/N and CL_CMP_CLK are present in both variants.
